nodes.name: mtl_vqvae1_config_seed11.json
nodes.summary: Seed-11 config for training the layer-wise/aggregate two-stage VQ-VAE over all LM layer hidden states on the PF-Short (PF_15XL) path-finding task (2 paths, 2 decoys, path length 2) using the multi-token-prediction (MTP) GPT checkpoint; sets codebook size 256, 25000 iterations, and output to PF_15XL/mtl_vqvae1_out_seed11.
